title: t-20261014-1d47: conflict-marker scanner + CI
author: dreamer2664
body:
## Summary
- `tools/scan_conflicts.py`: scans the tree for committed conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>` as line starts). Exit 2 with the hit list; 0 when clean. Reads each file once and splits on both boundaries (no TOCTOU between exists/open).
- `.github/workflows/conflicts.yml`: runs the scanner and its test suite on every push and PR.

## Rationale
During the 2026-10-15 session a rebase conflict got 'resolved' with a scripted marker-range deletion that silently removed 16 ledger rows. A committed-marker gate makes that class of accident impossible to land.

## Verification
- `python3 tools/scan_conflicts.py` → clean on current main (83-row ledger).
- `python3 tests/test_scan_conflicts.py` → 8/8 (positive hit on each of the three markers, clean pass, directory walk, byte-split reads).
